blocks.text: Inheritance (wirasat, yani baap se bete ko milne wali cheezein) mein ek class doosri class ke attributes aur methods le leti hai. Is se code reuse hota hai (dobara istemal hota hai) aur classes mein hierarchical (oopar-neeche, khandan jaisa) relationship banta hai: Animal parent hai, Dog aur Cat us ki subclasses.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Dog aur Cat classes ko bina indentation ke chhapti hai; aise IndentationError aata hai. def make_sound class ke andar aur print() def ke andar indented hona chahiye, jaise oopar.

Wazahat: Dog aur Cat, Animal se inherit karti hain. Har subclass make_sound() ko apne tareeqe se dobara likhti (override karti) hai: Dog().make_sound() "Bark!" aur Cat().make_sound() "Meow ! " print karta hai.

blocks.explanation: "Animal sound": base class apna version rakhti hai.

blocks.text: Dog class mein introduce() method likha hi nahi, phir bhi woh Animal se inherit ho kar (wirasat mein mil kar) chalta hai, jabke make_sound() Dog ka apna hai. pet_name badal kar Run karein.

items: class Dog(Animal): Dog, Animal ke attributes aur methods inherit karti hai (wirasat mein leti hai).
Override: subclass method apne tareeqe se likhti hai.
